description: Contours de la Garonne : Digues is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by eptb-garonne.fr. Location of the dikes on the Garonne - Excerpt from the Shepherd Maintenance Scheme. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Surroundings of the Garonne: Digues" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Digues, garonne, inspire. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
